name: S. C. Rudert
evidence: Expanded initials: S. C. Rudert = Prof. Dr. Selma C. Rudert, Professor for Social Psychology and Society, RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau (previously University of Koblenz-Landau); research on ostracism, social exclusion and social norms; heads the lab that also employs Christoph Kenntemich and Daan Brueckner-Collet, the two co-authors of 'Digital Echoes of Cultural Values'. LinkedIn snippet reads 'Selma Rudert - Professor for Social Psychology and ...' which matches the title on psy.rptu.de, so confirmed on organization + role. ResearchGate snippet 'Selma RUDERT | Professor' and the profile is the one returned alongside the 'Digital Echoes of Cultural Values' publication page and her Kenntemich/Brueckner-Collet co-authorships, so found. Email: psy.rptu.de is blocked by the egress proxy and no address appeared literally in any snippet; none constructed.
